_comment: Advisories the NPM Security Audit gate waives (scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs). Each entry needs a reason and a review_by date; an expired entry fails the gate again. Keep this list to advisories with no usable fix.

advisories.reason: Fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1 (advisory published 2026-10-30, no 3.x/9.x/10.x backport; checked 2026-11-04). It enters only through lint tooling (eslint 9, @eslint/eslintrc, eslint-plugin-import need minimatch 3.x; @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree needs 10.x), and 11.x drops the default export those call. Dev-only: globs come from first-party lint config, never from untrusted input, and nothing ships to the browser.

No fixed version exists: the advisory covers picomatch <= 4.0.7 and 4.0.7 is the latest release (advisory published 2026-10-19, range last updated 2026-11-17; registry and advisory checked 2026-11-18). It is a ReDoS through repeated extglobs in a glob pattern. By the lockfile's dependency trace, picomatch enters only through build, lint and test tooling: tailwindcss 3 (chokidar, fast-glob, micromatch), eslint-config-next, vite and vitest. The two paths under `dependencies` (tailwindcss-animate, and @janua/nextjs through @janua/ui) reach it through a peer dependency on tailwindcss; next itself does not require it. The patterns those tools match come from first-party config (Tailwind content globs, lint and test file patterns), not from request input. Not verified by inspecting the built bundle. Remove this entry when a fixed picomatch is published.
